# KabatOne

> KabatOne is a unified public safety and smart city software platform for governments, municipalities, and emergency-response agencies. It connects video management (VMS), AI video analytics, CAD/911 dispatch, GIS, field operations, and IoT sensors into a single command-center platform — turning detection into coordinated response. Primary markets: Mexico, Latin America, and the United States. Founded 2004.

## What KabatOne does
- Unifies siloed public safety systems (video, dispatch, GIS, sensors) into one operational platform (the "Avalon" unified platform / C5 command-center model).
- Aggregates cameras from any manufacturer (Hikvision, Axis, Dahua, Bosch, Hanwha), adds AI video analytics (LPR, behavior, forensic search), and correlates alerts with CAD dispatch and a live GIS map.
- Products: K-Dispatch (CAD / 911 dispatch), K-Video (VMS + AI video analytics), K-Safety (situational awareness), K-Traffic (intelligent traffic management), K-Connect (public-private camera integration).

## Products
- [K-Dispatch — CAD / 911 dispatch](https://kabatone.com/k-dispatch/): Computer-aided dispatch with AI-assisted unit recommendations, NG911 readiness, and native video/GIS integration.
- [K-Video — AI video platform](https://kabatone.com/k-video/): Video management (VMS) plus AI analytics across any-brand cameras.
- [K-Safety — situational awareness](https://kabatone.com/k-safety/): Unified operational picture across video, sensors, and field units.
- [K-Traffic — intelligent traffic management](https://kabatone.com/k-traffic/): Adaptive signal control, congestion and incident detection.
- [K-Connect — public-private camera integration](https://kabatone.com/k-connect/): Connects business and citizen cameras to the command center.

## Key concepts and guides
- [What is a Video Management System (VMS)?](https://kabatone.com/resources/what-is-video-management-software/): How VMS aggregates cameras, records, and adds AI analytics for public safety.
- [Best VMS Software — buyer's guide](https://kabatone.com/resources/best-vms-software/): How to choose a video management platform; VMS vs unified platform; cost and criteria.
- [What is Video Analytics?](https://kabatone.com/resources/what-is-video-analytics/): AI detection of intrusions, crowds, plates, and behaviors in surveillance video.
- [AI Video Analytics](https://kabatone.com/resources/ai-video-analytics/): How neural networks / deep learning power intelligent video analytics vs traditional rule-based analytics.
- [CCTV Video Analytics](https://kabatone.com/resources/cctv-video-analytics/): Adding AI detection to existing CCTV cameras of any brand, edge vs server.
- [What is CAD Dispatch Software?](https://kabatone.com/resources/what-is-cad-dispatch-software/): Computer-aided dispatch for the emergency incident lifecycle.
- [Best CAD Dispatch Software for 911 Centers](https://kabatone.com/resources/best-cad-dispatch-software/): Buyer's guide covering multi-agency, NG911, and MDT/GPS integration.
- [NG911 Software](https://kabatone.com/resources/ng911-software/): Next Generation 911 — text/video/data to 911, ESInet/i3, and CAD integration.
- [How C5 Command Centers Work](https://kabatone.com/resources/how-c5-command-centers-work/): The C5 model (Command, Control, Communications, Computing, Quality) used across Mexican cities.
- [What is a Real-Time Crime Center (RTCC)?](https://kabatone.com/resources/what-is-a-real-time-crime-center/): Integrating live video, analytics, LPR, and gunshot detection.
- [Best RTCC Software — vendors compared](https://kabatone.com/resources/rtcc-software/): Real-time crime center software buyer's guide; vendors (Axon/Fusus, Genetec, Hexagon, Mark43, Milestone, Motorola, Verkada) compared vs KabatOne's unified platform; selection criteria and cost.
- [What is a Public Safety Platform?](https://kabatone.com/resources/what-is-a-public-safety-platform/): Unifying products, industries, and integrations into one topical platform.
